title: Zellige in the Disk
blurb: Hyperbolic Map folds a panning zellige into an {8,3} Poincaré disk: two pantry ingredients composed. Phason flips stay off here: magnified, one discrete flip repaints the whole disk.
controls: Knobs: Möbius drift, Input area per tile, Tile size, Morph · Mutate rolls a new look · MIDI CC 21–23 + mod wheel
